# EC2 Auto Scaling

Reconcile group membership with local EC2 instance records.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `autoscaling` |
| Signing name | `autoscaling` |
| Wire protocol | AWS Query |
| API version | `2011-01-01` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | EC2 record reconciliation |
| Selected operations | 25 of 66 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#ec2-auto-scaling) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No mixed-instance policies, warm pools, lifecycle hooks or instance refreshes.
- No load balancer attachments, predictive scaling, notification delivery or metrics collection.
- Instances remain metadata-only.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
